name: JSL Industries Limited
about: JSL Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing of engineering goods in India. The company offers instrument transformers, such as cast resin indoor and outdoor type instrument transformers, outdoor metering units, outdoor CT and PT products, and cast resin components for switchgears; and LT switchboards, including custom-built power control and motor control centers, auto transformer starters, magnastart systems, distribution boards, and bus-ducts, as well as feeder, control, relay, and APFC panels. It also provides LT air circuit breakers; air break starters comprising DOL and star delta starters, single phase submersible pump controller, three phase DOL submersible pump controller, and three phase star-delta submersible pump controller; and oil-immersed starters and pump controllers. In addition, the company offers motors and pumps consisting of fan cooled squirrel cage induction motors, vertical solid shaft induction motors, vertical hollow shaft induction motors, induction generator, screen protected drip proof motors, slip-ring induction motors, mono-block pumps, and textile motors for loom, card, ginning, and ring frame. It serves engineering consultants, utilities, public sector organizations, various governments/semi-governments, and private industries. JSL Industries Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is based in Mogar, India.
